messages.content: You are a precise biomedical information extraction assistant. Follow the requested output format exactly and never add explanations.

Given the following text and a relational triplet extracted from it:

Text: Prednisone is a prescription corticosteroid (steroid) used to reduce inflammation, suppress an overactive immune system, and treat endocrine and metabolic disorders. Prednisone is used for a wide range of conditions, including severe allergies, asthma and COPD flare-ups, rheumatoid arthritis and other forms of arthritis, lupus, psoriasis and other skin conditions, ulcerative colitis, Crohn's disease, eye inflammation, some blood disorders, and low adrenal hormone levels.
Prednisone works by mimicking the effects of glucocorticoid hormones secreted naturally by our adrenal glands. Prednisone is a man-made (synthetic) version of these hormones. Prednisone is different from steroids taken to build muscle (anabolic steroids).
Prednisone belongs to the drug class called glucocorticoids, which are a type of corticosteroid.
Triplet: ["Prednisone", "used for", "ulcerative colitis"]

The relation 'used for' in the triplet is defined as 'The subject drug is used to treat or manage the medical condition specified by the object entity.' Choose a relation whose meaning and subject/object direction match the triplet even if the wording differs; choose 'None of the above' only if no candidate fits. Please answer by providing only the letter of your choice.

B. 'used in': The subject drug is utilized in the medical procedure or clinical context specified by the object entity.
